description: Block components, inline components, span attributes and the inline `{...}` attribute syntax.

cases.name: block-component-minimal
cases.description: A `::name` fence produces a `block_component` rendered as a plain `div`.

cases.name: block-component-attributes-are-filtered-and-sorted
cases.description: Class shorthands merge, `#id` becomes `id`, and rendered attributes are sorted.

cases.name: block-component-attribute-values-are-escaped
cases.description: Attribute values are HTML-escaped on output but kept verbatim in the AST.

cases.name: block-component-boolean-prop
cases.description: OMEP-0007: a value-less prop is exposed as `:key = "true"` and dropped from the HTML.

cases.name: block-component-non-html-attributes-stay-in-the-ast
cases.description: Only `class`, `id`, `data-*` and `style` reach the HTML; everything else remains available to plugins.

cases.name: inline-component-with-content
cases.description: `:name[content]{...}` renders as a `span` carrying only the HTML-valid attributes.

cases.name: inline-component-without-content
cases.description: A component whose attributes are all non-HTML renders as an empty `span`.

cases.description: The comark documentation example for span attributes.

cases.html: This is highlighted text in a paragraph.

cases.name: span-attributes-are-filtered
